findings.root_cause: retrieval candidate enters context before authorization
findings.remediation: authorize before context construction and revalidate returned metadata
fail closed and return zero protected chunks on PEP error

findings.root_cause: staged metadata is trusted without source-of-truth integrity validation
findings.remediation: compare staged envelope to source-of-truth metadata/hash and quarantine mismatches

findings.root_cause: retrieved content is treated as authority to trigger secondary retrieval/tool behavior
findings.remediation: treat retrieved content as untrusted data and prevent it from modifying authorization/tool policy

findings.root_cause: model-generated tool request is implicitly trusted
findings.remediation: bind deterministic tool policy to authenticated subject, action and allowlist
disable remote autoload and sanitize remote resource references

findings.root_cause: synthetic secret is included in model/provider context
findings.remediation: keep secrets outside prompts, index and provider payloads; verify boundary capture
